params.name: key
params.description: The key of the variable to retrieve.

items.docs: Returns a single variable by key with per-environment value overrides.

params.name: branch
params.description: The slug of a branch to use. This option can only be used when `environment` is `"development"`.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter variables by type. Supports 'public' or 'secret'.

params.name: after
params.description: The cursor to fetch entries after.

params.name: before
params.description: The cursor to fetch entries before.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of entries to fetch per-page.

items.docs: Returns a list of variables. When an environment is specified, returns per-environment variables. Otherwise, returns project-scoped variables with per-environment overrides.
